items.title: Case 1
items.text: A new hire polishes their weekly report with an approved AI tool, then rereads it

items.title: Case 2
items.text: An old hand puts AI-calculated quarterly growth into a report for the boss, unchecked

items.title: Case 3
items.text: Feeling much faster, a manager tells the whole team: every task goes to AI first

notes: Time for the first quiz. Three cases: is this a good way to use AI? Take a minute, talk it over with your neighbor if you like, then put your hand up and tell us what you think and why.
